home.title: Web3 Farm

home.phase: Phase 1: bind + daily points · Phase 2: BSC token & steal mechanic

hall.title: My Exhibition Hall
hall.subtitle: Your on-chain private gallery. Showcase digital assets, earn daily points, unlock slots — Season 0 snapshot gates airdrops and future gameplay.
hall.balanceHint: Trial points — Season 0 snapshot may unlock perks
hall.accrualStopped: Accrual paused — no claim for 72+ hours
hall.gridHint: Tap an empty slot to verify and bind Nobody from your wallet
hall.errUnlockOrder: Unlock slots in order — do the next one first
hall.errAlreadyBound: NFT already on display or slot unavailable
hall.rule1: Points accrue while connected; claim once every 24 hours
hall.rule2: Accrual stops after 72h without a claim; daily cap 1000 pts
hall.rule3: 2 slots free; only the next 2 unlock costs are shown, later slots stay hidden
hall.rule4: Each bound Nobody +100 pts/day (10 pts/day base without bindings)
hall.rule5: Points sync by wallet address in the cloud — same wallet on any device
hall.rule6: NFTs must stay in the bound wallet; sold or transferred NFTs are auto-unbound on visit/claim
hall.bindingsRemoved: These NFTs are no longer in your wallet — unbound, accrual stopped: {names}
hall.syncFailed: Cloud sync failed — check network and try again (points may not be saved)
hall.actionFailed: Action failed — confirm the wallet signature or try again

swap.title: NFT Swap
swap.subtitle: Both sides deposit items, confirm, then atomic swap. Whitelisted contracts only — on-chain proof, no fake images.
swap.security1: Only platform-registered collection contracts are allowed
swap.security2: ownerOf must match your connected wallet when adding
swap.security3: Images come from tokenURI metadata — no user uploads
swap.security4: Deposit escrow: transfer only agreed NFTs, no collection-wide approval; atomic swap when both deposit
swap.counterpartyHint: Share the room link. They can see your slots live and chat in the room.
swap.escrowPending: Escrow contract not configured: room sync and chat work now; set NEXT_PUBLIC_SWAP_CONTRACT after deploy for one-click settlement.
swap.createWithoutWallet: Create a room without wallet; connect before adding NFTs or confirming.
swap.executeHint: Both sides confirmed — approve escrow and execute atomic swap on-chain
swap.insufficientPoints: Not enough points — deposit costs {fee} pts. Claim in the hall first.
swap.depositHint: Both confirmed — transfer your slotted NFTs into the escrow contract
swap.depositAtomicNote: No collection-wide approval. When both sides deposit, the contract swaps atomically in one transaction.
swap.withdrawHint: Reclaim your NFTs if counterparty does not deposit within 10 minutes
swap.deadlineWaitingYou: Counterparty deposited — deposit yours before timeout
swap.deadlineExpiredHint: Click below to reclaim your NFTs
swap.waitMakerFirst: Wait for the room creator to deposit on-chain first
swap.swapCancelled: Swap cancelled — you can place NFTs and confirm again
swap.executeFailed: Transaction failed — check approvals and network
swap.chatSendFailed: Failed to send — refresh and try again
swap.chatWithoutWallet: Chat works without a wallet. Connect only to add NFTs or execute the swap.
swap.verifyHint: We query Ethereum mainnet for ownerOf and tokenURI. Only verified tokens enter slots.
swap.flow1: Both users join the same swap room
swap.flow4: After UI confirm, each party signs deposit txs to escrow
swap.flow5: Atomic swap when both deposit; 10-minute countdown after first deposit, reclaim on timeout
swap.errNotOwner: This NFT is not in the connected wallet — switch account

td.title: Little People
td.subtitle: Tower defense trial · Red Carpet Debut
td.refillFailed: Refill failed — check points or signature
td.startFailed: Cannot start — not enough stamina or run in progress
td.buyFailed: Purchase failed — not enough gold or signature rejected
td.runInProgressHint: Game progress lives in your browser — refresh or disconnect cannot resume. Tap Forfeit to unlock. Runs auto-clear after 2 hours.
td.exchangeFailed: Exchange failed — check points or signature
td.rulesHint: Points buy +30 stamina (stackable) or gold (100 pts→100 gold, cost doubles daily). Clear stages for more gold. Buffs last 24h.
td.shopHint: Spend gold on 24h buffs — expired buffs disappear
td.placementHint: Place units on green tiles, then start the battle
td.demoHint: Dev mode: data lives in memory only — refresh resets progress
td.buildHint: Tap green + tiles for「{mob}」({cost} pop · range {range}) · build anytime
td.mergeHint: Merge same crew type & level (max Lv5): inspect unit → Select merge source → tap another match
td.mergeSelectTarget: Tap matching unit to merge, or Cancel merge
td.dragHint: Drag to empty tile to move · onto matching unit to merge
td.inspectHint: Tap a unit on the map to see stats and traits
td.mergeSourceActive: Merge source selected · tap matching unit
td.starXpHint: Stars gain XP from kills and level up · XP bar on unit
td.rangeHint: Hover the map to see range circle
